newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker on dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 42.8250/8450 to the dollar on Monday, after some private banks purchased U.S. dollars from the interbank market, dealers said.
This compared with the previous close at 42.8250/8350.
Dealers said weakening of the call rates further fuelled dollar demand with banks switching to the dollar from local currency.
"The market was very active," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at 5.0 to 5.5 percent, down from Sunday's 5.0-6.5 percent.
